title: Dire kodiak / forest dragon transformation
summary: A dire kodiak reveals a forest dragon when driven below 80% health.
overview: A dire kodiak reveals a forest dragon when driven below 80% health.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Lower the dire kodiak to the transformation threshold with the group ready for a replacement target.
The kodiak disappears and the forest dragon appears at its location. Re-establish the tank’s target and hate immediately.
If the dragon is already present, the transformation is postponed instead of creating another copy.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
